# Troolify

> Troolify is a free, privacy-first online tools hub by the F9XR Team. Every tool runs 100% client-side in the browser, so your data never leaves your device. No accounts, no uploads, no tracking.

Key facts about Troolify:
- Free forever, no sign-up required
- 100% client-side processing, zero data retention
- Static site hosted on GitHub Pages at https://f9xr.github.io/troolify/
- Read the project README at https://github.com/f9xr/troolify

## Tools
- [Word Counter](https://f9xr.github.io/troolify/tools/text/word-counter.html): Live word, character, sentence, paragraph and reading-time stats as you type. Text never leaves the browser.
- [Numeronym Generator](https://f9xr.github.io/troolify/tools/text/numeronym-generator.html): Turn any phrase into an i18n-style numeronym (like i18n or k8s) or decode one back into its letter count.
- [JSON Formatter](https://f9xr.github.io/troolify/tools/coding/json-formatter.html): Format, validate, minify and copy JSON instantly without sending it to a server.
- [Code Beautifier](https://f9xr.github.io/troolify/tools/coding/code-beautifier.html): Turn source code into clean, colorful, self-contained HTML with syntax highlighting.
- [Schema Markup Generator](https://f9xr.github.io/troolify/tools/seo/schema-markup-generator.html): Create clean JSON-LD schema markup for LocalBusiness, Product, Article, FAQPage, Event and Review.
- [Multiline Slug Generator](https://f9xr.github.io/troolify/tools/seo/multiline-slug-generator.html): Convert multi-line text into SEO-friendly URL slugs with keyword optimization and stop-word removal.
- [YouTube Timestamp Link Generator](https://f9xr.github.io/troolify/tools/youtube/timestamp-link-generator.html): Create clickable timestamp links and instant video-description chapters for any YouTube video.
- [Song Length Calculator](https://f9xr.github.io/troolify/tools/audio/song-length-calculator.html): Calculate exact track runtime from BPM and bar repetitions.
- [Password Generator](https://f9xr.github.io/troolify/tools/misc/password-generator.html): Generate strong random passwords or memorable passphrases with custom length, character sets and entropy strength.
- [Password Entropy Calculator](https://f9xr.github.io/troolify/tools/misc/password-entropy-calculator.html): Measure password entropy in bits and estimate crack time across five real-world attack scenarios.
- [Ovulation Calculator](https://f9xr.github.io/troolify/tools/health/ovulation-calculator.html): Predict ovulation day, fertile window, peak fertility and upcoming periods from your last cycle.
- [Advance Average Calculator](https://f9xr.github.io/troolify/tools/statistics/advance-average-calculator.html): Find the mean, median, sum and count of any list of numbers instantly.
- [Markdown to Word Converter](https://f9xr.github.io/troolify/tools/converters/markdown-to-word-converter.html): Convert Markdown to Word instantly. Turn .md files into polished .docx documents, no signup needed.
- [Markdown to PDF Converter](https://f9xr.github.io/troolify/tools/converters/markdown-to-pdf-converter.html): Convert Markdown to PDF instantly. Turn .md files into clean, shareable PDF documents, no signup needed.
- [VAT Calculator](https://f9xr.github.io/troolify/tools/finance/vat-calculator.html): Add, remove or split VAT on any amount with tax rates for 50+ countries. 100% client-side.
- [URL Encoder & Decoder](https://f9xr.github.io/troolify/tools/coding/url-encoder-decoder.html): Encode or percent-decode URLs and text instantly for safe links and API work.
- [CSV to JSON Converter](https://f9xr.github.io/troolify/tools/coding/csv-to-json-converter.html): Convert CSV into clean JSON with custom keys and separators, fully in the browser.
- [SHA Hash Generator](https://f9xr.github.io/troolify/tools/coding/sha-hash-generator.html): Generate SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-384 or SHA-512 hashes via the native Web Crypto API.
- [Color Converter](https://f9xr.github.io/troolify/tools/image/color-converter.html): Convert any color between HEX, RGB and HSL with a live preview swatch.
- [Random Word Generator](https://f9xr.github.io/troolify/tools/text/random-word-generator.html): Generate random words from six curated lists - common, nouns, verbs, adjectives, animals or food.
- [Bra Size Calculator](https://f9xr.github.io/troolify/tools/health/bra-size-calculator.html): Find your bra size and sister sizes from underbust and bust measurements with a band and cup fit guide.
- [Body Fat Percentage Calculator](https://f9xr.github.io/troolify/tools/health/body-fat-percentage-calculator.html): Estimate body fat percentage with the US Navy method from a few tape measurements.
- [Lean Body Mass Calculator](https://f9xr.github.io/troolify/tools/health/lean-body-mass-calculator.html): Estimate lean body mass with the Boer formula, or sharpen it with a body fat reading.
- [Waist to Hip Ratio Calculator](https://f9xr.github.io/troolify/tools/health/waist-to-hip-ratio-calculator.html): Calculate your waist-to-hip ratio and WHO risk category from two tape measurements.
- [Macro Calculator](https://f9xr.github.io/troolify/tools/health/macro-calculator.html): Set protein, fat and carbohydrate targets from your TDEE and goal - cut, maintain or bulk.
- [Protein Intake Calculator](https://f9xr.github.io/troolify/tools/health/protein-intake-calculator.html): Find your daily protein target in grams by weight, activity and goal, with a per-meal split.
- [TDEE Calculator](https://f9xr.github.io/troolify/tools/health/tdee-calculator.html): Estimate total daily energy expenditure and maintenance calories with Mifflin-St Jeor and activity levels.
- [Heart Rate Zones Calculator](https://f9xr.github.io/troolify/tools/health/heart-rate-zones-calculator.html): Find your max heart rate and five training zones by age and resting heart rate using Karvonen.
- [Steps to Calories Calculator](https://f9xr.github.io/troolify/tools/health/steps-to-calories-calculator.html): Turn your step count into calories burned based on weight and pace, with a distance estimate.
- [Pregnancy Due Date Calculator](https://f9xr.github.io/troolify/tools/health/pregnancy-due-date-calculator.html): Estimate your due date from LMP or conception using Naegele's rule, with gestational age and trimester.

- [HVAC Load Calculator](https://f9xr.github.io/troolify/tools/hvac/hvac-load-calculator.html): Aggregate preliminary cooling and heating components - glass, people, equipment, lighting and infiltration - into a transparent sensible/latent breakdown with tons and thermal kW.
- [BTU Calculator](https://f9xr.github.io/troolify/tools/hvac/btu-calculator.html): Convert any thermal capacity figure between BTU/h, kBtu/h, MBH, watts, kW, horsepower, refrigeration tons, kcal/h and kJ/h - all computed privately in your browser.
- [BTU to Tons](https://f9xr.github.io/troolify/tools/hvac/btu-to-tons.html): Convert any BTU/h figure to nominal refrigeration tons (12,000 BTU/h per ton) and see the equivalent thermal kilowatts - done locally in your browser.
- [Room BTU Calculator](https://f9xr.github.io/troolify/tools/hvac/room-btu-calculator.html): Create a documented, area-based preliminary BTU/h estimate from floor area, ceiling height, sun exposure, occupants and insulation.
- [BTU per Square Foot](https://f9xr.github.io/troolify/tools/hvac/btu-per-square-foot.html): Compare a stated thermal capacity against a documented floor area - output as BTU/h per square foot with typical comfort ranges.
- [Tons to BTU](https://f9xr.github.io/troolify/tools/hvac/tons-to-btu.html): Convert nominal refrigeration tons to BTU/h and thermal kilowatts - 1 ton equals 12,000 BTU/h - calculated instantly in your browser.
- [CFM Calculator](https://f9xr.github.io/troolify/tools/hvac/cfm-calculator.html): Convert room volume and target air changes per hour (ACH) into the required CFM airflow, with a metric m3/h cross-check.
- [ACH Calculator](https://f9xr.github.io/troolify/tools/hvac/ach-calculator.html): Calculate the air changes per hour (ACH) implied by a stated CFM airflow - the reverse-check on any ventilation target.
- [CFM per Square Foot](https://f9xr.github.io/troolify/tools/hvac/cfm-per-square-foot.html): Normalize a known airflow by the served floor area - output as CFM per square foot against typical ranges.
- [CFM to m3/h](https://f9xr.github.io/troolify/tools/hvac/cfm-to-m3h.html): Convert airflow from cubic feet per minute to cubic metres per hour (and L/s) without changing the design basis.
- [m3/h to CFM](https://f9xr.github.io/troolify/tools/hvac/m3h-to-cfm.html): Convert airflow from cubic metres per hour back to CFM and L/s - without changing the flow basis.
- [Duct Size Calculator](https://f9xr.github.io/troolify/tools/hvac/duct-size-calculator.html): Estimate a theoretical round duct diameter from a documented CFM and target face velocity - with area and velocity cross-checks.
- [Rectangular Duct Size](https://f9xr.github.io/troolify/tools/hvac/rectangular-duct-size.html): Calculate a preliminary rectangular duct width and height from CFM, target velocity and aspect ratio.
- [Duct Velocity](https://f9xr.github.io/troolify/tools/hvac/duct-velocity.html): Check the actual face velocity in fpm (and m/s) the way a real duct run behaves - from CFM and duct dimensions.
- [Duct Cross-Sectional Area](https://f9xr.github.io/troolify/tools/hvac/duct-cross-sectional-area.html): Calculate the inside face area of a round or rectangular duct in square inches, square feet and square metres.
- [Equivalent Diameter](https://f9xr.github.io/troolify/tools/hvac/equivalent-diameter.html): Compare rectangular and round equal-friction duct geometry with the ASHRAE formula - so a rectangular size can move into round duct math.
- [Duct Friction Loss](https://f9xr.github.io/troolify/tools/hvac/duct-friction-loss.html): Estimate straight round duct loss transparently - Darcy-Weisbach with the Swamee-Jain friction factor - in inches w.g..
- [Refrigeration Capacity](https://f9xr.github.io/troolify/tools/hvac/refrigeration-capacity.html): Calculate refrigerant-side capacity from refrigerant mass flow and enthalpy difference - output in BTU/h, tons and kW.
- [Refrigerant Superheat](https://f9xr.github.io/troolify/tools/hvac/refrigerant-superheat.html): Find the suction-line temperature difference above saturation - measured line temperature minus saturation temperature.
- [Refrigerant Subcooling](https://f9xr.github.io/troolify/tools/hvac/refrigerant-subcooling.html): Find the liquid-line temperature difference below saturation - saturation temperature minus the measured liquid line temperature.
- [Psychrometric Calculator](https://f9xr.github.io/troolify/tools/hvac/psychrometric-calculator.html): Calculate dew point, humidity ratio, moist-air enthalpy and approximate wet-bulb temperature from one documented air state.
- [Heat Pump Operating Cost](https://f9xr.github.io/troolify/tools/hvac/heat-pump-operating-cost.html): Translate a documented thermal load and matched COP into electricity use, cost, and a comparison against resistance heating.
- [Fan Pulley RPM](https://f9xr.github.io/troolify/tools/hvac/fan-pulley-rpm.html): Calculate driven fan RPM from motor speed and the pitch diameters of both sheaves - with belt speed on the side.
- [Motor Sheave Size](https://f9xr.github.io/troolify/tools/hvac/motor-sheave-size.html): Screen a motor sheave pitch diameter for a supported target fan speed - the reverse of the pulley RPM calculation.
- [V-Belt Length](https://f9xr.github.io/troolify/tools/hvac/v-belt-length.html): Estimate open-drive V-belt pitch length and both wrap angles from sheave pitch diameters and centre distance.
- [Fan Law Calculator](https://f9xr.github.io/troolify/tools/hvac/fan-law-calculator.html): Estimate same-system airflow, static pressure and brake-power changes from a speed or flow change - the fan laws, applied honestly.
- [Fume Hood Face Velocity](https://f9xr.github.io/troolify/tools/hvac/fume-hood-face-velocity.html): Calculate the opening-average face velocity from exhaust airflow and the clear sash area - a documented, measured value.
- [Fume Hood Traverse](https://f9xr.github.io/troolify/tools/hvac/fume-hood-traverse.html): Summarize equal-area fume-hood velocity readings into average, spread and uniformity - without inventing pass/fail criteria.
- [Multi-Hood Exhaust Planner](https://f9xr.github.io/troolify/tools/hvac/multi-hood-exhaust-planner.html): Compare the connected exhaust flow with a documented active and standby scenario - so exhaust sizing has an honest demand basis.
- [Fume Hood Exhaust Load](https://f9xr.github.io/troolify/tools/hvac/fume-hood-exhaust-load.html): Estimate the thermal conditioning load of fume-hood exhaust/make-up air from airflow and a moist-air enthalpy difference.

## Categories
- [AI Tools](https://f9xr.github.io/troolify/tools/ai/index.html): Prompt, text, image and code generation utilities.
- [Audio Tools](https://f9xr.github.io/troolify/tools/audio/index.html): BPM, song length and audio production utilities.
- [Developer Tools](https://f9xr.github.io/troolify/tools/coding/index.html): Coding, debugging and web development utilities.
- [Converters](https://f9xr.github.io/troolify/tools/converters/index.html): Convert data between formats instantly.
- [Cooking Tools](https://f9xr.github.io/troolify/tools/cooking/index.html): Cooking, recipe and kitchen helpers.
- [Crypto Tools](https://f9xr.github.io/troolify/tools/crypto/index.html): Cryptocurrency and blockchain calculators.
- [Finance Tools](https://f9xr.github.io/troolify/tools/finance/index.html): Money, savings and finance calculators.
- [Fun & Games](https://f9xr.github.io/troolify/tools/fun/index.html): Fun, games and entertainment utilities.
- [Health Tools](https://f9xr.github.io/troolify/tools/health/index.html): Health, fitness and wellness tools.
- [HVAC Tools](https://f9xr.github.io/troolify/tools/hvac/index.html): Heating, ventilation and air conditioning - load, airflow, duct design, refrigeration and lab exhaust utilities.
- [Image Tools](https://f9xr.github.io/troolify/tools/image/index.html): Resize, compress, convert and edit images.
- [Misc Tools](https://f9xr.github.io/troolify/tools/misc/index.html): Useful utilities that don't fit anywhere else.
- [PDF Tools](https://f9xr.github.io/troolify/tools/pdf/index.html): PDF creation, merging and conversion tools.
- [Prompt Tools](https://f9xr.github.io/troolify/tools/prompts/index.html): Ready-made prompts for AI workflows.
- [SEO & Marketing](https://f9xr.github.io/troolify/tools/seo/index.html): Search engine optimization and marketing tools.
- [Statistics](https://f9xr.github.io/troolify/tools/statistics/index.html): Statistics, math and data analysis tools.
- [Text Tools](https://f9xr.github.io/troolify/tools/text/index.html): Format, convert, analyze and manipulate text.
- [Time Tools](https://f9xr.github.io/troolify/tools/time/index.html): Time, date and scheduling tools.
- [Video Tools](https://f9xr.github.io/troolify/tools/video/index.html): Video editing and conversion tools.
- [YouTube Tools](https://f9xr.github.io/troolify/tools/youtube/index.html): YouTube utilities for creators, marketers and support teams.
